import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/jmagar/workspace/labby/.worktrees/issue-771-server-lifecycle')
evidence=root/'docs/tasks/issue-771-server-lifecycle/evidence'
expected={'baseline':0,'snapshot-red':101,'snapshot-green':0,'gateway-all-features':0,'clippy':0,'gateway-default':101,'fmt':0,'module-reachability':0,'docs':0,'enrichment-default-isolated':0,'enrichment-default-serial':0,'ownership-audit':0,'gateway-default-serial':101,'lane-c-default':0,'docs-final':0,'docs-final-r2':0}
receipts={}
for name,exit_code in expected.items():
    record=json.loads((evidence/(name+'.json')).read_text())
    assert record['exit_code']==exit_code,(name,record['exit_code'])
    assert record['timed_out'] is False,name
    assert hashlib.sha256((evidence/(name+'.log')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==record['log_sha256'],name
    receipts[name]=record
for name in ('gateway-all-features','lane-c-default','clippy','fmt','module-reachability','docs-final-r2','gateway-default-serial'):
    for path,digest in receipts[name]['test_source_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,(name,path)
for source,saved in [('crates/labby-gateway/tests/issue_771_server_lifecycle.rs','snapshot-red-test.rs.txt'),('crates/labby-gateway/tests/issue_771_server_lifecycle/snapshot.rs','snapshot-red-adapter.rs.txt')]:
    assert hashlib.sha256((evidence/saved).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==receipts['snapshot-red']['test_source_sha256'][source]
for name in ('gateway-default','gateway-default-serial'):
    log=(evidence/(name+'.log')).read_text()
    assert len(re.findall(r'^test gateway::enrichment::provider::tests::.* \.\.\. FAILED$',log,re.M))==5,name
    assert '1478 passed; 5 failed; 5 ignored' in log,name
assert '1540 tests run: 1540 passed' in (evidence/'gateway-all-features.log').read_text()
assert '28 passed; 0 failed' in (evidence/'lane-c-default.log').read_text()
git=lambda p,*args: subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),*args],text=True).strip()
changes=git(root,'diff','--name-only','138ef902dc1842daf883a6e7710b140fbfaf53c0','HEAD').splitlines()
assert changes and all(path.startswith(('crates/labby-gateway/tests/issue_771_server_lifecycle','docs/tasks/issue-771-server-lifecycle/')) for path in changes)
gate=root.parent/'issue-771-gate0'
assert git(gate,'rev-parse','HEAD')=='a5e3f78ca55e52c64b2013a8fae3d26a9bf5819e'
assert git(gate,'rev-parse','HEAD:docs/adr/0007-durable-mcp-task-routing.md')=='3ad75a27b9c46a4ff211cef10365f46057fdaba2'
assert not git(gate,'status','--porcelain')
print(json.dumps({'verified_receipts':len(receipts),'validated_source_files':len(receipts['gateway-all-features']['test_source_sha256']),'gate0_unchanged':True,'only_lane_c_paths_changed':True,'intentional_red_characterization':'snapshot-red','unresolved_baseline_runs':['gateway-default','gateway-default-serial'],'all_feature_test_passes':1540,'all_feature_skips':5,'default_lane_c_test_passes':28},indent=2))
